services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Sunset Cruise - 1.5 Hours - Up to 6 Guests Unwind on a 1.5-hour shared sunset cruise across Lake Hefner, designed for small groups seeking a relaxed and scenic evening on the water. As the sun lowers over the horizon, warm tones of gold and coral reflect across the lake, creating a calm and memorable backdrop. Guests are welcome to bring their own beverages. Valid ID required for guests 21 and over. Complimentary cola, lemon-lime soda, and water are provided on board. Cozy blankets and comfortable seating complete the experience. blurb: OKC Charters offers private, hosted boat experiences in Oklahoma City on Lake Hefner and Arcadia Lake. Enjoy sunset, night, and Day Party Cruises designed for relaxation and celebration. This is not a boat rental-each experience includes a captain and hostess. Lake Hefner cruises focus on views and vibes, while Arcadia Lake experiences include swimming and floating.
